Trust and data principles

A useful diagnosis must be explainable, proportionate and safe to challenge.

JourneyIQ is an operational diagnostic proposition. Any live use of client data requires engagement-specific controls and evidence before transfer.

Minimum necessary data

Request only the operational evidence needed to answer the agreed question. Patient, clinical and unnecessary personal data remain outside scope.

Visible uncertainty

Data gaps, assumptions, confidence and alternative explanations remain visible.

Controlled access & retention

Agree storage, processors, access, deletion and retention before any client data moves.

Human review

Accountable operators review findings and recommendations. The diagnostic supports judgement; it does not replace it.

How AI fits

Core metrics and financial logic should be deterministic, documented and reconcilable. AI may assist with approved unstructured material or drafting narrative, but it should not become the untraceable source of a KPI or value claim.

JourneyIQ is not a medical device, quality-management system or substitute for qualified legal, privacy, cybersecurity or regulatory advice.

Before a live data engagement

  • Agree the question and minimum dataset
  • Confirm permitted use and processors
  • Remove restricted or unnecessary fields
  • Define review and assumption approval
  • Document retention and deletion

Trust starts with a narrower question and less data, not a longer list of promises.
